submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve sprite correction. Edit image1 only, keeping the red fire-talisman BOY identity, camera, whole-canvas framing, head/body size, face, hair, costume and the existing two arm-to-hand chains (RIGHT five-card fan, LEFT bell). Images2–4 preserve this boy's identity and established rendering. Image5 is ONLY a motion/mechanics reference: borrow the clear planted shoe and knee/ankle loading, never the archer girl, bow, green outfit, or her framing. Correct only the pelvis-to-legs into WEIGHT-BEARING COMPRESSION on the forward NEAR anatomical LEFT foot. Plant its shoe fully flat in its existing forward lane, with heel and toe on one flat ground plane and only thin gold outsole rim visible; no broad underside facing camera. Bend the support knee over the foot, flex the ankle so the shin and knee visibly take weight. Rear FAR anatomical RIGHT leg remains bent backward AIRBORNE, heel upper-right and toe lower-left. Both shoe long axes follow SW lower-left, no splayed toes. Image5 shows the near-left supporting foot/knee mechanic only. Maintain this boy's head size, upper body, arms/hands and five-card fan/bell and exact camera framing; no whole-figure zoom or recenter. Output one full1254x1254 RGBA transparent sprite. Do not add ground art or shadows. No global rescale or recenter.
